theme.en: Policy Money and Inference Bets Reshape Supply
theme.zh: 政策资金与推理押注重塑供给

dek.en: Public incentives are steering new fab and AI-hub plans while chip companies chase inference demand, advanced packaging, and faster storage links. Memory pricing remains the clearest near-term signal that the AI supply chain is still tight.
dek.zh: 公共激励正推动新晶圆厂和AI枢纽计划，芯片公司则围绕推理需求、先进封装和更快的存储互连展开布局。存储价格仍是AI供应链偏紧最直接的短期信号。

title.en: AI & Accelerators
title.zh: AI与加速器

title.en: Huawei Pangu Pro Reportedly Trains 505 Billion Parameters Without Nvidia
title.zh: 报道称华为盘古Pro在无Nvidia条件下训练5050亿参数

summary.en: A Tech Times report says Huawei's Pangu Pro trained a 505-billion-parameter model without Nvidia hardware, while questioning what the underlying supply chain implies. The claim matters because it turns attention to the practical availability of domestic accelerators, networking, and memory rather than model size alone.
summary.zh: Tech Times报道称，华为盘古Pro在未使用Nvidia硬件的条件下训练了5050亿参数模型，同时也追问其背后的供应链含义。该消息的关键不只在模型规模，更在于国产加速器、网络与存储能否获得稳定供给。

title.en: MediaTek Targets 15–20% Data-Center Share; First AI Accelerator Enters Production in Q4
title.zh: MediaTek上调数据中心份额目标至15%–20%，首款AI加速器将于第四季度投产

summary.en: MediaTek said in its Q2 2026 earnings call that it now targets a 15–20% share of the data-center market and expects its first AI accelerator to enter production in Q4. The target moves the company from client and mobile silicon toward a far more capital- and supply-intensive server market.
summary.zh: MediaTek在2026年第二季度财报电话会上表示，已将数据中心市场份额目标定为15%–20%，并预计首款AI加速器将在第四季度投产。这一目标意味着公司正从客户端和移动芯片进一步切入资本与供应链要求更高的服务器市场。

title.en: Foundry & Manufacturing
title.zh: 晶圆代工与制造

title.en: Intel Reportedly Uses Overtime Incentives for Ohio Fab as EMIB-T Yield Nears 90%
title.zh: 报道称Intel为俄亥俄晶圆厂发放加班奖金，EMIB-T良率接近90%

summary.en: Wccftech reports that Intel is paying overtime bonuses to accelerate work on its Ohio fab complex, with an operational target cited for 2031. The report also says EMIB-T package yield is approaching 90%, leaving substrate yield as the reported remaining issue; advanced-packaging execution is central to Intel's foundry pitch.
summary.zh: Wccftech报道称，Intel正通过加班奖金加快俄亥俄晶圆厂综合体建设，报道提及其运营目标为2031年。报道还称EMIB-T封装良率接近90%，基板良率仍是剩余问题；先进封装的量产执行力是Intel代工战略的核心环节。

title.en: Memory & Storage
title.zh: 存储与存储系统

title.en: Memory Prices Reportedly Drive a 178.8% Jump in Semiconductor Exports
title.zh: 报道称存储价格推动半导体出口增长178.8%

summary.en: Digital Today attributes a 178.8% jump in semiconductor exports to memory prices reaching $45. The reported move illustrates how pricing in commodity and AI-adjacent memory can quickly dominate trade and revenue statistics when supply remains constrained.
summary.zh: Digital Today将半导体出口178.8%的增长归因于存储价格升至45美元。该报道显示，在供给仍受约束时，通用存储与AI相关存储的定价能够迅速主导贸易和营收数据。

title.en: Kioxia Launches CM10 SSD Family for PCIe Gen6
title.zh: Kioxia推出面向PCIe Gen6的CM10 SSD系列

summary.en: Kioxia introduced the CM10 SSD family for the PCIe Gen6 generation, spanning 2.5-inch and EDSFF form factors as well as air- and liquid-cooled configurations. The line also covers PCIe Gen5 and Gen6 options and two NAND generations, broadening the qualification choices for data-center storage deployments.
summary.zh: Kioxia推出面向PCIe Gen6时代的CM10 SSD系列，覆盖2.5英寸和EDSFF形态，并提供风冷与液冷配置。该产品线还涵盖PCIe Gen5和Gen6选项以及两代NAND，为数据中心存储部署扩大了认证与配置选择。

title.en: Policy & Geopolitics
title.zh: 政策与地缘政治

title.en: US Announces $874 Million CHIPS Act AI Push, With GlobalFoundries Taking the Largest Award
title.zh: 美国宣布8.74亿美元CHIPS法案AI计划，GlobalFoundries获最大份额

summary.en: A report says the Trump administration unveiled an $874 million CHIPS Act initiative focused on AI, with GlobalFoundries receiving the largest award. Directing funds toward AI-related capacity and capabilities could reshape which domestic suppliers are positioned to serve government-backed demand.
summary.zh: 报道称，特朗普政府公布了一项总额8.74亿美元、聚焦AI的CHIPS法案计划，GlobalFoundries获得其中最大一笔奖励。资金投向AI相关产能与能力，可能重塑哪些美国本土供应商更有机会承接政府支持的需求。

title.en: India Breaks Ground on Semiconductor Manufacturing Unit in Uttar Pradesh
title.zh: 印度在北方邦为半导体制造项目奠基

summary.en: India's prime minister laid the foundation stone for a semiconductor manufacturing unit in Uttar Pradesh, according to News On AIR. The project adds another regional manufacturing initiative as India seeks to turn policy support into physical capacity and a local supplier base.
summary.zh: 据News On AIR报道，印度总理为北方邦一座半导体制造项目举行奠基仪式。随着印度寻求把政策支持转化为实体产能和本土供应链，该项目为其区域制造布局再添一环。

title.en: Challengers
title.zh: 挑战者

title.en: Etched Receives SK hynix Investment for Custom AI-Inference Chips
title.zh: Etched获SK hynix投资，推进定制AI推理芯片

summary.en: TechRadar reports that Etched has secured an investment from SK hynix after placing a bet on custom AI-inference chips. The investment ties a specialist inference-chip effort to a leading memory supplier, a notable alignment as memory bandwidth and capacity shape inference-system design.
summary.zh: TechRadar报道称，专注定制AI推理芯片的Etched获得了SK hynix投资。这项投资将专用推理芯片公司与领先存储供应商连接起来；在存储带宽和容量日益影响推理系统设计的背景下，这种协同值得关注。

theme.en: Ferroelectrics Push Memory and Compute Integration
theme.zh: 铁电技术推进存储与计算融合

dek.en: This week's device papers focus on ferroelectric memory windows, disturbance tolerance, and vertical integration. Compute-in-memory work focuses on reducing conversion and accumulation overhead without abandoning configurable precision.
dek.zh: 本周器件论文聚焦铁电存储窗、抗扰性和垂直集成。存算一体研究则着力降低转换和累加开销，同时保持可配置精度。

title.en: Devices & Process
title.zh: 器件与工艺

title.en: Ionic FET Uses an Ozone-Oxidized Barrier to Improve ECRAM Retention
title.zh: 采用臭氧氧化阻挡层提升ECRAM保持特性的离子场效应晶体管

papers.authors: Jongseon Seo, Geonhui Han, Laeyong Jung, et al.

summary.en: The authors add an ultrathin ozone-oxidized barrier to a WO3−x/HfOx ionic-FET ECRAM stack to suppress ion back-diffusion without blocking useful ion injection. They report a roughly 7.6-V memory window, stable 3-bit operation, and endurance above 10^5 program/erase cycles; retention above 10^6 is a room-temperature projection that still needs system-level validation.
summary.zh: 作者在WO3−x/HfOx离子FET ECRAM堆栈中加入超薄臭氧氧化阻挡层，以抑制离子回扩散，同时保留有效的离子注入。器件报告约7.6 V存储窗、稳定的3 bit操作和超过10^5次的写擦耐久度；超过10^6的室温保持时间为推算值，仍需系统级验证。

title.en: Five-Layer Selector-Free Ferroelectric Diodes for 3D Cross-Point Memory
title.zh: 用于三维交叉点存储的五层无选通铁电二极管

papers.authors: Wenjuan Zhou, Ruizhan Yan, Renhao Xue, Mansun Chan, Xiwen Liu

summary.en: This work experimentally demonstrates a monolithic five-layer cross-point-memory stack using hafnia-based ferroelectric diodes and an all-ALD process. The approximately 10-nm-per-tier stack reaches an ON/OFF ratio near 10^3, nonlinearity up to about 600, 50-ns programming, and endurance beyond 10^7 cycles, directly addressing selector and layer-uniformity limits in vertical memory.
summary.zh: 该研究实验演示了采用HfO2基铁电二极管和全ALD工艺的单片五层交叉点存储堆栈。该堆栈每层约10 nm，实现约10^3的开关比、最高约600的非线性度、50 ns编程和超过10^7次耐久度，直接应对垂直存储中的选通器与层间均匀性难题。

title.en: La-Doped HfO2 Improves FeFET Disturbance Immunity
title.zh: La掺杂HfO2提升FeFET抗扰性

papers.authors: Sheung Hun Kim, Youngkeun Park, Batzorig Buyantogtokh, et al.

summary.en: The study replaces conventional HfZrO2 with La-doped HfO2 in a ferroelectric FET and reports 2Pr of 47.8 μC/cm². Relative to HfZrO2 devices, the La-doped FeFETs show a 16.0% wider memory window and smaller threshold shifts during disturb cycling, making the material choice relevant to dense nonvolatile-memory arrays.
summary.zh: 研究以La掺杂HfO2替代传统HfZrO2作为铁电FET层，并报告47.8 μC/cm²的2Pr。与HfZrO2器件相比，La掺杂FeFET的存储窗扩大16.0%，且在扰动循环中的阈值漂移更小，因此该材料选择对高密度非易失存储阵列具有意义。

title.en: AI Accelerators & Compute-in-Memory
title.zh: AI加速器与存算一体

title.en: Compute-Fusion SAR ADC Reduces Overhead in Reconfigurable CIM
title.zh: 计算融合SAR ADC降低可重构存算一体开销

papers.authors: S. Q. Yan, J. Wang, S. Liu, et al.
papers.venue: IEEE Transactions on Very Large Scale Integration (VLSI) Systems

summary.en: This 40-nm CMOS compute-in-memory macro reuses its capacitor array for charge-domain MACs and SAR conversion, then combines quantization storage with in-memory serial accumulation. The authors report a 44% transistor-count reduction, up to 250.73 TOPS/W and 255.5 GOPS, with selectable 1-, 2-, and 4-bit signed or unsigned weights; reported task accuracy remains below full-precision baselines on CIFAR-10.
summary.zh: 这款40 nm CMOS存算一体宏复用电容阵列完成电荷域MAC和SAR转换，并把量化结果存储与存内串行累加结合。作者报告晶体管数量减少44%、最高250.73 TOPS/W和255.5 GOPS，并支持1、2、4 bit有符号或无符号权重；其在CIFAR-10上的报告精度仍低于全精度基线。

title.en: MoS2-Enhanced 2T2R Cell Enables One-Step In-Memory XNOR for BNNs
title.zh: MoS2增强型2T2R单元实现面向BNN的一步存内XNOR

papers.authors: Zhoujie Pan, Yuwan Hong, Dingyi Zhang, Yanming Liu, He Tian
papers.venue: IEEE Transactions on Very Large Scale Integration (VLSI) Systems

summary.en: The paper proposes a MoS2-transistor-enhanced antisymmetric 2T2R in-memory XNOR cell that completes write and compute in one step for binary neural-network workloads. It argues that the device choice can reduce static power and support monolithic 3D integration, while the BNN mapping makes quantization error an explicit system-level trade-off.
summary.zh: 论文提出一种由MoS2晶体管增强的非对称2T2R存内XNOR单元，可针对二值神经网络在一步内完成写入与计算。作者认为该器件选择能降低静态功耗并支持单片三维集成，同时配套的BNN映射把量化误差作为明确的系统级权衡。

title.en: Circuits & Modeling
title.zh: 电路与建模

title.en: Reduced Landau–Khalatnikov Model Captures HfO2 Ferroelectric Dynamics
title.zh: 简化Landau–Khalatnikov模型刻画HfO2铁电动态

papers.authors: Bing Chen, Haoran Yu, Wenhao Liu, et al.

summary.en: The authors develop a reduced multi-domain Landau–Khalatnikov model for HfO2-based ferroelectrics and match simulated P–V behavior to fabricated Hf0.5Zr0.5O2 samples across anneal temperatures. They use it to predict FRAM read waveforms and simulate negative capacitance in a 1FE-capacitor/1-resistor cell, offering a lighter-weight bridge from measured device behavior to circuit exploration.
summary.zh: 作者开发了用于HfO2基铁电材料的简化多畴Landau–Khalatnikov模型，并使模拟P–V特性与不同退火温度下制备的Hf0.5Zr0.5O2样品相吻合。该模型还用于预测FRAM读出波形和模拟1个铁电电容加1个电阻单元中的负电容效应，为从实测器件到电路探索提供了更轻量的桥梁。
